newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank chairman happy with central bank measures.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank chairman happy with central bank measures.

text.p: The chairman of Sweden's central bank, Kjell-Olof Feldt, said on Wednesday he was happy with Tuesday's five party agreement to strengthen the Riksbank's position.
"As far as I can see, the agreement coincides with the views I have had, so I'm pretty satisfied," Feldt told Reuters.
"They have distributed work concerning currency policy in a way that makes the Riksbank independent in regards to monetary policy."
The Riksbank will be responsible for running monetary policy while the government will decide what exchange rate system will be used, the agreement said.

The agreement gives the Riksbank a new management structure, enshrines the price stability target in law, forbids authorities to instruct the Riksbank on issues concerning monetary policy and strengthen's the Riksbank governor's position.
